verifications.claim: As of April 2, 2026, President Trump has appointed Todd Blanche as the acting attorney general.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'serve as the acting attorney general after the abrupt firing of his predecessor, Pam Bondi' (April 2, 2026); R2: 'President Donald Trump announced Thursday... Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche would replace her as acting attorney general' (Apr 2, 2026); similar in R3-R7.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources dated April 2, 2026, directly state Trump appointed Blanche as acting AG on that date.

verifications.claim: Todd Blanche is replacing Pam Bondi.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'acting attorney general after the abrupt firing of his predecessor, Pam Bondi'; R2: 'Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche would replace her as acting attorney general'; R3: 'Bondi would serve as acting attorney general' [replaced by Blanche]; consistent across all.
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly state Blanche is replacing Bondi as acting AG.

verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Bondi started in February 2025 and was removed in April 2026.
